title: Bowtie Pasta with Smoked Flavor
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta dish, infused with the rich taste of smoked yum.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bowtie pasta according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, combine yum and smoke over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Once the pasta is al dente, drain and add to the pan with the yum mixture.
Stir in cold and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
